perm.title: File access needed
perm.text: To edit game files in shared storage, allow the app "All files access".

pick.title: Choose the game folder
pick.text: The folder with texdb/, audio/, data/ (e.g. SFRP64 or com.rockstargames.gtasa/files).

tex.title: Textures
tex.compactAsk: Rebuild the database without old data of replaced textures? This may take a while.
tex.formatHint: Auto: DXT5 for images with transparency, DXT1 otherwise. RGBA8888 is lossless but 4–8× larger.
tex.mipsHint: Smaller copies for distant objects. Usually needed.
tex.rleHint: Like the original databases: less space, same quality.
tex.alphaHint: 0 — opaque, 1 — alpha test (cutout), 2 — blending. Auto: 0 without alpha, otherwise the value of the replaced texture or 2.
tex.camnormHint: Camera-facing normals (foliage, grass). Off — a replaced texture keeps its old value.
tex.streamHint: Streamed loading. Off — a replaced texture keeps its old value.
tex.overwriteHint: Otherwise textures with the same name are skipped.
tex.nameHint: The name is the file name without extension. Case-insensitive: Wall matches wall.
tex.removeAsk: Remove {0} from the database? Models that use them will lose their textures.

img.title: IMG archives
img.rebuildAsk: Rebuild the archive? Files are rewritten back to back, without gaps left by replacements. Needs free space the size of the archive.

audio.title: Audio
audio.hint: An .osw pack is an uncompressed ZIP with mp3 files plus an .idx index. The game plays tracks by number, so replacing keeps the order.

adapt.title: Mod adaptation
adapt.hint: On PC every model has its own .txd; on mobile all textures live in shared caches (gta3 etc.) where equal names clash. Adaptation gives every texture a unique "prefix_random" name, writes the new names into the .dff and drops unused textures. Several models and .txd files can be adapted together: one .txd may serve many models; a texture is looked up in the .txd named like the model first, then in the others.
adapt.retexHint: A retexture only changes textures; the game models stay the same. Every texture of the .txd replaces the texture with the same name in every database that has it.
adapt.prefixHint: Latin letters, digits, _. Up to 14 chars.
adapt.missing: Not in the .txd (kept as is — taken from the game)
adapt.toTexdb: Import textures into a database right away
adapt.toImg: Add the models to an archive right away
adapt.addMissing: Add missing ones to a database

settings.title: Settings
settings.backupHint: Before the first change a file is copied to /sdcard/GTAUniversalTool/backup (once, the original). To restore, copy it back.
settings.aboutText: Free open-source app for modding mobile GTA SA.
